# Ven diagram (Upset package)
# Keep the genes overlaping between EQTM genes and SEO
1- I want the genes present only in SEO, when comparing with genes in cCOPD.
2- The specific for SEO find the overlap with EQTm genes.(From the upset plot looks like 30 genes).

```{r}
result.dir.plots <- "../../results/07_DGE/Final_results/plots/"
dir.create(result.dir.plots, recursive = TRUE)

```


```{r}
# Extract unique gene symbols from each dataset
seo_genes <- unique(DGE.SEO$gene.symbol)
ccopd_genes <- unique(DGE.cCOPD$gene.symbol)
eqtm_genes <- unique(EQTm.genes$gene.symbol)

# 1. Find genes specific to SEO (present in SEO but NOT in cCOPD)
seo_specific_genes <- base::setdiff(seo_genes, ccopd_genes)
cat("Number of SEO-specific genes:", length(seo_specific_genes), "\n")

# 2. Find overlap between SEO-specific genes and EQTm genes
seo_specific_in_eqtm <- base::intersect(seo_specific_genes, eqtm_genes)
cat("Number of SEO-specific genes that overlap with EQTm:", length(seo_specific_in_eqtm), "\n")

# Display the overlapping genes
if(length(seo_specific_in_eqtm) > 0) {
  cat("Overlapping genes:", paste(seo_specific_in_eqtm, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Create a binary matrix for UpSet plot
all_genes <- unique(c(seo_genes, ccopd_genes, eqtm_genes))

binary_matrix <- data.frame(
  Gene = all_genes,
  SEO = as.integer(all_genes %in% seo_genes),
  cCOPD = as.integer(all_genes %in% ccopd_genes),
  EQTm = as.integer(all_genes %in% eqtm_genes)
)

```

```{r}
library(UpSetR)
library(tidyverse)

# Create UpSet plot highlighting SEO-specific genes
# Create the UpSet plot with corrected syntax
plot <- upset(binary_matrix,
            nsets = 3,# Number of sets to show
            show.numbers = TRUE, 
            nintersects = NA, # Show all intersections; set to a number to limit
            order.by = "freq", # Order intersections by frequency
            decreasing = TRUE, # Sort in descending order
            mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.35), # Ratio of main bar plot to matrix plot
            number.angles = 0, # Angle of numbers on top bars
            text.scale = c(1.3, 1.3, 1, 1, 1.5, 1), # Scale text sizes
            point.size = 4, 
            line.size = 1,
            mainbar.y.label = "Intersection Size",
            sets.x.label = "Set Size",
            sets.bar.color = "gray", # Change bar color
            matrix.color = "black")   # Change matrix dot color


p_as_gg <- ggplotify::as.ggplot(plot)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  paste0(result.dir.plots,"upset_plot_eqtms_gex.svg"),
  plot = p_as_gg,
  device = "svg", 
  dpi = 600,                 
  width = 7,
  height = 5,     
  units = "in",
  #type = "cairo" 
)

# Print the UpSet plot
print(plot)
```

# Master table
Should contain 38 CpGs with thei significance+ genes from EQTMs with thei significance+ GEX genes with their significance

```{r}
# Set-up final DMPs df
file.cpgs <- "../../results/04_DM/new_final_only_specific_SEO_DMPs.csv"

cpgs.58 <- read_csv(file.cpgs, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    "logFC.cpg" = logFC,
    "P.Value.cpg" = P.Value,
    "adj.P.Val.cpg" = adj.P.Val,
    "abs.delta.mean.cpg" = abs.delta.mean
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "CpG.id", "logFC.cpg", "P.Value.cpg", "adj.P.Val.cpg", "abs.delta.mean.cpg", "met.status"
  )

# Set-up eqtm significant DMPs-genes
eqtm.sig <- EQTm.genes %>%
  mutate(
    "logFC.eqtm" = logFC,
    "P.Value.eqtm" = P.Value,
    "adj.P.Val.eqtm" = adj.P.Val,
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "gene.symbol", "geneID", "CpG.id", "logFC.eqtm", "P.Value.eqtm", "adj.P.Val.eqtm"
  )

# Set-up DGE specific in SEO
dge.seo <- DGE.SEO %>%
  mutate(
    "logFC.GEX" = logFC,
    "logCPM.GEX" = logCPM,
    "P.Value.GEX" = PValue,
    "FDR.GEX" = FDR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "gene.symbol", "logFC.GEX", "logCPM.GEX", "FDR.GEX"
  )

# merge dge.SEO and eqtm.SEO
merged.df <- eqtm.sig %>%
  left_join(dge.seo, by = "gene.symbol") %>%
  mutate(sig.GEX.genes = !is.na(logFC.GEX))

# Final master table
df.main.table <- cpgs.58 %>%
        left_join(merged.df, by = "CpG.id")%>%
        mutate(sig.cpg.eqtm = !is.na(gene.symbol)
               )%>%
        distinct()


# save
result.dir <- "../../results/"
main.table <- file.path(
  paste0(result.dir, "main_table_cpgs_eqtms_gex.csv")
)
write.csv(df.main.table, main.table, row.names = FALSE)


# print
df.main.table
```

# Venn diagram top30 CpGs overlap with top30 eqtms cpgs, sorted by FDR

```{r}
library(VennDiagram)

top30.cpgs <- df.main.table %>%
  filter(!is.na(adj.P.Val.cpg)) %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val.cpg) %>%               # lowest p-values first
  distinct(CpG.id, .keep_all = FALSE) %>%  # keep one per CpG.id (the best one)
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%                   # take top 30 unique
  pull(CpG.id)

top30.eqtm.cpgs <- df.main.table %>%
  filter(!is.na(adj.P.Val.eqtm)) %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val.eqtm) %>%               # lowest p-values first
  distinct(CpG.id, .keep_all = FALSE) %>%  # keep one per CpG.id (the best one)
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%                   # take top 30 unique
  pull(CpG.id)

# Install packages if needed
# install.packages("VennDiagram")
# install.packages("RColorBrewer")
# install.packages("gridExtra")

library(VennDiagram)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gridExtra)

# Create publication-quality Venn diagram
venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = list(
    top30.CpGs = top30.cpgs,
    top30.CpGs.eQTMs = top30.eqtm.cpgs
  ),
  filename = NULL,
  # Color scheme suitable for publications (colorblind friendly)
  fill = brewer.pal(3, "Set2")[1:2], # or c("#66c2a5", "#fc8d62")
  alpha = 0.7,
  # Font sizes
  cex = 1.8,        # Size of numbers in circles
  cat.cex = 1.2,    # Size of category labels
  cat.fontface = "bold",
  # Category positions and colors
  cat.dist = c(0.08, 0.08),
  cat.pos = c(-20, 20),
  cat.col = brewer.pal(3, "Set2")[1:2],
  # Remove title if you'll add it separately
  main = NULL,
  main.cex = 1.8,
  main.fontface = "bold",
  # Margin and scaling
  margin = 0.08,
  scaled = TRUE,
  # Circle line properties
  lwd = 2,
  lty = "solid",
  # Resolution
  resolution = 600
)

# For high-resolution saving
tiff("../../results/07_DGE/Final_results/plots/vennDiagram/VennDiagram.tiff", width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300, compression = "lzw")
grid.draw(venn.plot)
dev.off()

# For PDF (vector format - preferred for publications)
pdf("../../results/07_DGE/Final_results/plots/vennDiagram/VennDiagram.pdf", width = 8, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)
grid.draw(venn.plot)
dev.off()

# To display on screen with better quality
grid.draw(venn.plot)
```

```{r}
boxplot.single.gene <- function(gene, values, type, pheno.color.var, id.mapping.df, 
                               ensembl.id.col, symbol.col, result.dir) {
  
  # Create result directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(result.dir)) {
    dir.create(result.dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Create mapping from symbol to ENSEMBL ID
  mapping <- id.mapping.df[, c(ensembl.id.col, symbol.col)]
  colnames(mapping) <- c("ensembl", "symbol")
  
  # Find ENSEMBL ID for requested gene
  ensembl_id <- NULL
  gene_label <- NULL
  
  # Check if gene is already an ENSEMBL ID in the matrix
  if (gene %in% rownames(values)) {
    ensembl_id <- gene
    gene_label <- gene
  } 
  # Check if gene is a symbol that can be mapped
  else {
    matched <- mapping[mapping$symbol == gene & mapping$ensembl %in% rownames(values), ]
    if (nrow(matched) > 0) {
      ensembl_id <- matched$ensembl[1]
      gene_label <- gene
    } else {
      stop(paste("Gene not found or not mappable:", gene))
    }
  }
  
  # Prepare data for the single gene
  plot.data <- data.frame(
    expression = as.numeric(values[ensembl_id, ]),
    condition = pheno.color.var
  )
  
  # Create the boxplot
  box.plot <- ggplot(
    plot.data,
    aes(x = condition, y = expression, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      alpha = 0.9,
      outlier.shape = NA,  # Hide outliers since we'll show all points
      width = 0.6,
      lwd = 1.2,           # Make all boxplot lines thicker
      fatten = 2.5         # Specifically make the median line even thicker
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom( 
      aes(color = condition),
      dodge.width = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.9,
      size = 4,
      shape = 21,             # shape 21 = circle with fill and border
      color = "black",        # border (outline) color
      stroke = 1.2            # thickness of the outline
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Gene Expression for", gene_label),
      x = "Sample type",
      y = paste0("Gene Expression (", type, ")"),
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkred", "cadetblue")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred", "cadetblue")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid = element_blank()   # Remove grid lines
    )
  
  # Create filename
  filename <- file.path(result.dir, paste0("boxplot_gene_", gene_label, ".svg"))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = box.plot,
    device = "svg",
    width = 5,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(box.plot)
}
```
